_note: Rank designs for gen_codex_rank_designs.py. Owner direction 2026-10-10: higher ranks clearly more distinctive than lower ones, communicating a higher tier, lore-accurate, while the character stays identifiable as the base design. '2' = Seasoned veteran, '3' = Elite; rank 3 is redrawn from the rank-2 idle sprite, so each tier builds on the last. Owner rule 2026-10-10: Codex is only asked to redraw the attached idle sprite in the stated way, so these notes describe visible changes only -- no character names and no setting terms. The lore behind each design is recorded in docs/ART_CREDITS.md. Only units that rank up past their top level are listed (troopers, militia and smugglers are promoted instead).
